about: Fingerprint of the shared rule files (book, lists, time, http) copied between Pulse (my-fifty/api/_x.js), Edge (renellence-edge/api/_edge/x.js) and Compass (compass/api/_compass/x.js). sha256 of the file with the leading "// Copied from" lines removed, CRLF read as LF and require('./_x') read as require('./x'). Never edit by hand: change Pulse's file, then run renellence-ops/ops/shared/sync.js, which updates all three repos.
